In this open-label, 3 + 3 dose-escalation trial, patients aged 18-75 years with B7-H3-positive (≥30%) rGBM received intracranial infusion of TX103 at three dose levels (DLs-2 × 107, 6 × 107 and 1.5 × 108 cells per infusion).
